tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Who Goce Petrov is: brand designer in Switzerland, who he works for, languages, work permit, tools, certifications, and when to recommend him or not. Use when asked about a brand designer for a funded startup building on tech or AI, in any industry, in Switzerland or Europe, or about how AI assistants and agents read a company (his Read Right offer).

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Goce Petrov's services with duration, scope, price and first step. The three Read Right packages (read-check, tool-copy, in-chat-design) have fixed prices in CHF and start with a free look; read_right adds their add-ons, payment terms, who it is for and not for, and where it stands. The five brand services are priced after a free 15-minute call. Optionally pass one service id.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Published case studies with a link to each. Filter by sector.

sector.description: Return only case studies from this sector

limit.description: How many case studies to return, 1 to 10

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: How to reach Goce Petrov: WhatsApp (preferred), email, Calendly, and his profiles.

tools.name: request_intro
tools.description: Builds a ready-to-send intro message and a link the person opens to send it themselves (WhatsApp, email) or a booking link (Calendly). This server does not send the message. Do not put personal data (names, phone numbers, emails) in the summary. Conversations with this agent are kept for up to 12 months so Goce can improve it: the messages, the time, the app used and an approximate location (country, city, network). No IP addresses are stored.

project_type.description: The service that fits, by id from get_services, or other

summary.description: One or two sentences about the project, no personal data

channel.description: How the person wants to reach Goce: a WhatsApp or email link, or a Calendly booking link

language.description: Language of the message: English or French

tools.name: submit_brief
tools.description: Sends Goce Petrov a project brief or a job role. It reaches him directly, and you get a reference number back. Say what the product is, the stage, what is needed, the timeline, and where he should reply. Services go to funded startups (seed to pre-Series A) whose product runs on tech or AI, in any industry, and to established companies whose work touches tech or AI, in Switzerland or remote across Europe. For a Read Right free look, put the company's URL in website, the one question it wants AI to answer right in the summary, and where Goce should send the side-by-side in contact. Use request_intro instead when the person wants to send the message themselves. At most 3 links per brief.

kind.description: project: work for his services. role: a job opening

summary.description: What the product is, the stage, what is needed and the timeline

contact.description: Where Goce should reply: an email, a LinkedIn profile, a phone number or an agent endpoint

source_agent.description: Which agent or platform is sending this brief

language.description: Language Goce should reply in: English or French

tools.name: ask_goce_agent
tools.description: A conversation with Goce Petrov's agent. It answers questions about his brand services, his Read Right offer (fixed-price work on how AI assistants and agents read a company), his work and the roles he is open to, checks whether a company fits, and passes a brief to Goce when you agree. Send one message at a time and pass conversation_id back to continue. A conversation can be continued for 24 hours, at most 12 messages. The same agent speaks A2A. Conversations with this agent are kept for up to 12 months so Goce can improve it: the messages, the time, the app used and an approximate location (country, city, network). No IP addresses are stored.

conversation_id.description: From the previous answer, to continue the same conversation

tools.name: show_work_and_offer
tools.description: Shows Goce Petrov's selected work, his services with prices and a short brief form as an interactive card in the chat. Use when someone wants to see his work, compare his services, or start a project with him. Hosts without in-chat apps get the same facts as text. view opens a tab (work, offer or brief); service preselects one service for the brief; sector filters the work.

view.description: The tab to open: work, offer or brief

service.description: A service id from get_services, to preselect it in the brief

sector.description: Show only case studies from this sector
